nl_request: Find the support cases opened on or after 2024-07-22 and before 2025-07-13 with a severity of at least 3, for customers on the pro or enterprise tier, that have at least two update notes and at least one refund greater than 750 with an approval date recorded. Return the IDs of the matching support cases.
reference_sql:
SELECT sc.id
FROM support_cases AS sc
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = sc.customer_id
WHERE c.tier IN ('pro', 'enterprise')
  AND sc.opened_at >= '2024-07-22' AND sc.opened_at < '2025-07-13'
  AND sc.severity >= 3
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_notes AS n
    WHERE n.case_id = sc.id AND n.note_type = 'update'
  ) >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM refunds AS r
    WHERE r.case_id = sc.id AND r.amount > 750 AND r.approved_at IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY sc.id
